reserves.name: Physical silver bars (LBMA Good Delivery, Asian vault custody)

reserveReview.rationale: Matrixdock reports total supply, physical bullion weight, and bar count, and states that XAGm is backed by 99.9% LBMA-accredited Good Delivery silver stored in Asia. It also identifies Bureau Veritas physical audits and vault asset statements.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Matrixdock live bullion and supply disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete direct reserve asset is physical silver; the reviewed page does not provide a vault-by-vault allocation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Matrixdock identifies reputable Asian vaults and Bureau Veritas physical audits but does not name the custodians or publish segregation, insolvency, rehypothecation, or vault-share terms.
